aabb.text: Write `CheckCollision` for two GameObjects as axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABB – AABB): they collide when they overlap on the x axis and on the y axis.
aabb.hint: On x: `one.Position.x + one.Size.x >= two.Position.x && two.Position.x + two.Size.x >= one.Position.x`; the same with y and the heights; `return collisionX && collisionY;`.

do-collisions.text: Write `DoCollisions`: for every brick that is not destroyed yet, if the ball collides with it, destroy it – unless it is solid. Call it in `Update` after moving the ball.
do-collisions.hint: `for (GameObject& box : game.Levels[game.Level].Bricks)` (a reference, so `box.Destroyed = true` changes the level's brick), `if (!box.Destroyed)`, `if (CheckCollision(Ball, box))`, `if (!box.IsSolid) box.Destroyed = true;`. `DoCollisions(game);` after `Move(Ball, dt, game.Width);`.

circle.text: Write `CheckCollision` for the ball and a GameObject (AABB – circle): find the point of the box closest to the ball's centre (clamp the centres' difference to the box's half extents) and test whether it is less than `Radius` away.

hint.opengl: An overload above `DoCollisions`: `bool CheckCollision(BallObject& one, GameObject& two)`. `center = one.Position + one.Radius`, `clamped = glm::clamp(difference, -aabb_half_extents, aabb_half_extents)`, `closest = aabb_center + clamped`, `return glm::length(closest - center) < one.Radius;`.
hint.vulkan: An overload above `DoCollisions`: `bool CheckCollision(BallObject& one, GameObject& two)`. `center = one.Position + one.Radius`, `clamped = glm::clamp(difference, -aabb_half_extents, aabb_half_extents)`, `closest = aabb_center + clamped`, `return glm::length(closest - center) < one.Radius;`.
hint.d3d12: An overload above `DoCollisions`: `bool CheckCollision(BallObject& one, GameObject& two)`. `XMVECTOR center = XMLoadFloat2(&one.Position) + XMVectorReplicate(one.Radius);`, the box's centre and half extents with `XMVectorSet`, `XMVectorClamp(difference, -aabb_half_extents, aabb_half_extents)`, `return XMVectorGetX(XMVector2Length(difference)) < one.Radius;`.
